pages.text: The Fuel Canner fills fuel cells with liquid: 10,000 mb per cell, at 1,000 mb/tick and with no energy cost.$(br2)Operation is automatic: empty cell in → filled → full cell out. Connecting fluid and item pipes allows unattended operation.

$(bold)Contents:$(reset) Nether Compound or Pure fuel from the $(l:akaishi:fuel_processor)Energy Processor$(/l), and Advanced or Ultimate Mixture from the $(l:akaishi:fuel_mixer)Fuel Mixer$(/l).$(br2)Filled cells are carried to the $(l:akaishi:reactor)Reactor$(/l); the top tier must first be blended in the Mixer.
The overview is in $(l:akaishi:liquid_fuel)Liquid Fuel Chain$(/l); the $(l:akaishi:reactor)Reactor$(/l) is where the cells are burned.
